parsed_profile_json.title: EXHAUST FRAME FLEX SEALS
parsed_profile_json.purpose: To inform users of inspection recommendations for the flex seals installed
parsed_profile_json.compliance_category_text: Maintenance - Identifies maintenance guidelines or best practices for reliable equipment operation.
scope_of_work: Inspect the flex seals during yearly planned borescope inspections
service_recommendation_line_items: Inspect units in operation that have installed the GEN0, GEN1, or GEN2 flex seal configuration during yearly planned borescope inspections.

If any indications are observed during planned borescope inspections (signs of wear at the exhaust frame pipe/ring or flange side; cracks, misalignment, bending, disengagement, and/or liberation), report findings to engineering for disposition.
Monitor the unit for 3AO elevated wheel space temperatures and exhaust frame blower alarms; report any unusual observations to engineering for disposition.

source_snippets.snippet: To inform users of inspection recommendations for the flex seals installed
Inspect the flex seals during yearly planned borescope inspections
GE recommends inspecting the units in operation that have installed the GEN0, GEN1, or GEN2 flex seal configuration during yearly planned borescope inspections.

If any of the following indications are observed during planned borescope inspections, report findings to engineering for disposition:
• Signs of wear at the exhaust frame pipe/ring or flange side
• Cracks, misalignment, bending, disengagement, and/or liberation
It is also recommended to monitor the unit for 3AO elevated wheel space temperatures and exhaust frame blower alarms; report any unusual observations to engineering for disposition.
Historically, flex seals have in some cases experienced wear, cracking, misalignment, bending, disengagement, and/or liberation.
7F and 9F units with GEN0, GEN1, or GEN2 flex seal configuration installed
This TIL is applicable as long as GEN0, GEN1, or GEN2 flex seal configuration is installed.

GEN0
SS410 Flex seal
GEN1
SS347 Flex seal
GEN2
SS410 coated Flex seal
